author: thomreis
body:
#### PR description:

This PR updates the `sampleOfInterest()` function of the ECAL Phase 2 TP digis to point to the sample containing the BX0 TPs. The previous code was still from the legacy TP digis where the behaviour was different.
With this update the getter functions for encoded ET, spike flag, and time return the values for the BX0 instead of -1.

#### PR validation:

Passes 34434.612 with the returned values of the getters matching the directly accessed sample at index 0.
title: Update sample of interest function of ECAL Phase 2 TP digis to point to BX0
